item.title: Attend A 3-Day Photography Residency Focused On Building A Sustainable Creative Practice
item.description: Chennai's Pause Workshop Edition 3 Offers A Residential Space For Reflective Image-Making The workshop explores self-worth, doubt, creative anxiety, and the pressures of validation in a hyperconnected world and sustaining a creative practice.

item.description: A Third Space In Hyderabad Offers Community Dining Through Themed Menus & Collaborative Dinners With communal tables, and handwritten menus, Jungshi aims to create a sense of belonging through food.

item.title: Could ‘Iss Tarah’ Help Bridge The Chasm Between Homegrown Indie & Playback Music?
item.description: Sonu Nigam Steps Into The Indie Soundscape On Chaar Diwaari’s ‘Iss Tarah’ 'Iss Tarah' feels less like a Bollywood song disguised as indie, and more like a conversation between two artists who come from different worlds.
